prompts.name: 01-fiche-epuree
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: high fidelity mobile web DETAIL page for ONE outgoing booking request on Coliclic.
Input image is a STYLE reference only: preserve its brand, compact typography, fine borders, white cards on #FAFAFA, navy routes and green status. Do NOT show the bookings list. Create a standalone detail PAGE, not a modal or bottom sheet.
Portrait 1024x2048 requested, one flat mobile screen, no device frame, perspective, promotional captions or watermark. Realistic Poppins typography, equivalent mobile width 430 logical px. Keep information concise, comfortable spacing, balanced hierarchy, no giant title or icon. No card inside another card.
Exact palette: navy #023047 titles, cyan #219EBC interactive controls, orange #FB8500 logo, white #FFFFFF, background #FAFAFA, border #E8E8EC, gray #6B6B6B. Accepted green #10B981 with darker green label on pale green pill. Cancellation quiet red #EF4444 text only. No purple, gradients or heavy shadows.
Small app header: hamburger, wordmark EXACT "Coliclic" with Coli orange and clic navy, navy circular AT avatar. Then "← Demandes envoyées" back link to the list, NOT dashboard.
SAME demo data for every variant. One request title "Poisson", pill "Acceptée", metadata "TRK-05-15 · 18 oct. 2026, 09:47".
Route "Nantes" / "France" to "Abidjan" / "Côte d’Ivoire". Planned "Départ · 22 oct. 2026, 10:00" and "Arrivée prévue · 23 oct. 2026, 18:00". These are scheduled travel times, NOT tracking milestones.
Parcel details "Poids" "3 kg", "Description" "Colis emballé avec soin.", "Destinataire" "tuoadama17@gmail.com". Contact belongs to PARCEL RECIPIENT, not traveler. An understated text link "Ajouter une photo" with tiny camera icon represents optional missing parcel photo, never a giant upload placeholder.
Traveler "Voyageur", small initials avatar "AK", name "Amadou K.", rating "4,8 · 12 avis".
Tariff summary "3 kg × 10 €/kg" and "Total estimé" "30 €". Quiet small explanatory copy "Règlement à convenir avec le voyageur." NO pay button, paid label, commission or invoice claim. Do not invent live tracking, delivered status, QR code, verification badge or arrival progress.
ONE cyan primary CTA "Contacter le voyageur" opens messaging, shown only ONCE. Secondary "Annuler la demande" in quiet red text clearly lower emphasis. Keep all text readable, full cities and email not truncated. Cancellation available because request accepted. Layout can be vertically compact full page but no overlap/cropping. Do not repeat traveler, tariff or parcel info. Avoid dense miniature text.
DIRECTION 1: EDITORIAL FLAT DETAIL. White continuous page with thin horizontal dividers, NO enclosing big card. Header compact. Title Poisson + green Accepted pill inline, small metadata below. Prominent simple horizontal route Nantes → Abidjan with countries secondary. Inline scheduled departure/arrival below. Then tidy plain sections 'Colis', 'Destinataire', 'Voyageur', 'Estimation' with aligned label-value information, very few icons. One small 3 kg text badge beside Colis, not a large tile. Primary full-width CTA and cancellation text at page bottom. Extremely restrained, refined consistent typography.
